title: Exchange holiday calendar known to the product (G-07-4)
reference_behaviour: The product keeps a holiday calendar and uses trading holidays in its numbers (a holiday-decay insight).
ours: Row 7 treats every weekday 09:15-15:30 IST as open, so an exchange holiday reads as waiting. REQ-114 AC-7 uses the ADR-119 calendar with dated holidays (row 11, being built).
